# Founder Brand

Your brand designer. The skill reads the positioning the founder pack already found (founder/idea.md, founder/marketing.md, founder/competitors.md and the buyer panel results) and builds the brand from it, not from taste. It proposes ten name candidates across different styles, shortlists three, and lists the checks to run before choosing: trademark searches in the official registers (for example USPTO, CIPO, EUIPO, UKIPO), domain availability, and social handles on Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube, stating plainly that only a trademark lawyer confirms a name and nothing is registered until you register it. It then writes the one-line promise, three tagline options, the voice in three adjectives with a do and a don't for each, and a look brief: 2 to 3 colours with hex values and a contrast check, one display and one text typeface you have the right to use, a logo brief, and the first five customer touchpoints. Output: founder/brand.md. Not legal advice on trademarks.
